title: 'It's Not Powerful Enough': GTA 6 Will Never Run at 60fps on PlayStation 5 Pro

Back To Top Home › News › GTA 6 GTA 6 Will Never Get a 60fps Update on PlayStation Pro as It's 'Not Powerful Enough'
 Console yourself.
 By  Tom Phillips Updated : Nov 18, 2026 12:50pm UTC Add IGN on Google 0 4 There's bad news for any GTA 6 fans still hoping for a 60fps option on PlayStation 5 Pro. 
 While Sony's beefier PS5 is arguably the most powerful console on the market today, even it is unable to run Rockstar's new masterpiece at 60fps. That's according to the game's technology production director Marc Chambers, who admitted that the PS5 Pro could only do so much.
 Somewhat controversially, GTA 6 targets 30fps across all of its supported console platforms, with the same rate on everything from the under-powered Xbox Series S all the way up to PS5 Pro.
 GTA 6: Photo Mode Gallery
 View 27 Images Naturally, there are other differences — and the game's PS5 Pro version has a few extra bells and whistles. But anyone expecting a better frame rate will need to temper their expectations — at least, perhaps, until the game's PC version arrives.
 "While the PS5 Pro's central processor is slightly better than the PS5 base console, it is not powerful enough to run the game's complex simulation at higher frame rates," Chambers told Kotaku .
 That said, PS5 Pro still offers other improvements, he continued. "Our base presentation makes use of ray-traced reflections and global illumination," Chambers noted. "On the PS5 Pro, this is enhanced with the addition of ray-traced shadows, as well as overall added clarity through the use of PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR). The PS5 Pro features an upgraded graphics processor and upscaling technology that we leverage to increase the game's visual fidelity."
 Speaking to IGN, Rockstar's co-studio head and head of development Rob Nelson said that "too much" of GTA 6 would have to fundamentally change for the game to target 60fps. "Too much, too much," he said in our big GTA 6 interview that went live today . "It wouldn’t have been acceptable to anybody. The simple answer is, when you ask the technical team, they're, like, 'Have you seen it?' There’s too many compromises that would've had to have been made to do that, is the short answer."
 Today also brings more detail on how GTA 6 fares while running on Xbox Series S , where it is one of the first games to use AMD's FSR 4.1 on Xbox to upscale the graphically demanding game from 720p to 1080p.
 IGN has everything you need for the launch of GTA 6, including the GTA 6 global release times , as well as details on the last-minute PS5 update you'll need to download . In case you missed it, last night we learned the real-life identity of GTA 6's Lucia . And we're now live with our GTA 6 launch blog , which we'll use to fill you in on everything else about the game over the coming hours.
